notShown.why: It never shows a net worth or debt figure: js/clarity.js only swaps the words after a timer. Your real figures are in the Net worth tracker, linked below.

notShown.what: The "EMI Time Machine" slider ("Future Wealth Lost", 12% over 10 years).
notShown.why: The page does not compound the money: it multiplies the EMI by 120 and then by 1.8, a rough rule. For an EMI of Rs 10,000 it shows Rs 21.6 lakh, whereas Rs 10,000 a month for 10 years at 12% (SIP formula) comes to about Rs 23.2 lakh. The phone has the real calculators (SIP, Opportunity Cost), so the rough slider is not copied.

notes: The website's order-of-operations list marks Step 1 "DONE" and Step 2 "CURRENT" for everyone. That is the page's example, not your progress, so those labels are left out.

sections.heading: What You Own vs What You Owe

blocks.text: Don't jump to Step 5 (Investing) before fixing Step 3 (Emergency Fund).
Income Clarity
Know exactly what hits your bank account vs what is "CTC".
Rule: You cannot manage what you do not measure.
Expense Control
The Leak: "Chalta Hai" spending on weekends.
The Fix: Track "Needs" vs "Wants" for 30 days. Kill 2 subscriptions you don't use.
Target: Save at least 20% of Income.
Emergency Fund
Before buying stocks, keep 6 Months of Expenses in a Liquid Fund/FD.
Why? So you don't sell your investments when life hits you.
Insurance (Protection)
Health: 5L Base + 20L Super Top-up.
Life: Term Insurance (20x Annual Income). Do not mix insurance with investment (ULIP).
Investing (Growth)
Now you are ready to beat inflation.
> Once you see your money clearly,
> Decisions stop being scary.
